protocol.normal_gate: Every task/N and task/A block has three cases and at least two correct-exclusive native successes.

ramekin.text: pick up the black bowl next to the ramekin and place it on the plate
ramekin.A: Initially, the black bowl farther from the cookies is next to the ramekin.
ramekin.X: Initially, the black bowl closer to the cookies is next to the ramekin.
ramekin.U: Initially, the plate and the ramekin are both resting on the table surface.

plate.text: pick up the black bowl next to the plate and place it on the plate
plate.A: Initially, the black bowl farther from the ramekin is next to the plate.
plate.X: Initially, the black bowl closer to the ramekin is next to the plate.
plate.U: Initially, the plate and the ramekin are both resting on the table surface.

quantization.note: Explicit bitsandbytes defaults used by upstream load_in_4bit=True; unquantized modules use bfloat16.

spec.attention_note: PyTorch SDPA instead of upstream flash_attention_2; this configuration is validated independently.

input.native_prompt:
In: What action should the robot take to {task_label.lower()}?
Out:

spec.advance_rule: Load and real-observation smoke check, then original task8 baseline; paired N before A; no X/U or automatic main-model promotion.
